title: Preview the broad edit
hook: A broad replacement can change matches you did not mean to touch.

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: Inspect every exact-match replacement before applying it.

objective: Inspect every exact-match replacement before applying it.

claims.text: Scenario, hook and prediction: A broad replacement can change matches you did not mean to touch. What should a broad edit preview expose? Correct option: All affected matches. All fixture labels, example words, dates, task durations and file fields are stipulated exercise data.
claims.source: Explicit exercise fixture in src/lib/lifehacks/studyCatalog.ts and pure rules in studyModels.ts. All times, sizes, deadlines and outcomes describe this exercise only; no empirical productivity or learning effect is inferred. FC LH-1 (session 2, received by message): verified; see company/reviews/lifehacks-200/fact-check-LH1-2026-10-14.md.

claims.text: The preview marks every exact match. The applied edit changes each marked token, making its scope inspectable; it does not determine whether the replacement was appropriate.
claims.source: Derivation from the explicit exercise fixture in src/lib/lifehacks/studyCatalog.ts and transformations in src/lib/lifehacks/studyModels.ts; app documentation below provides command/filter context, not evidence of productivity gains or of every fixture-specific choice. Microsoft Learn, Keyboard accelerators, Common Keyboard Accelerators and scope caveats; retrieved 2026-10-13: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/apps/develop/input/keyboard-accelerators . Shortcuts depend on app, platform and locale; this exercise models the command, not a global keyboard binding. FC LH-1 (session 2, received by message): verified; see company/reviews/lifehacks-200/fact-check-LH1-2026-10-14.md.

claims.text: Every displayed result is computed from the visible exercise state: edit. Local command model; app and locale can differ. The reveal reports this same state and never translates its score into a personal productivity or memory benefit. At the preview step the reveal reads: The preview marks 2 exact matches, at positions 1 and 3; previewing did not rewrite the tokens.
claims.source: src/lib/lifehacks/studyModels.ts and src/components/lifehacks/StudyLesson.tsx, preview-replace-all fixture in src/lib/lifehacks/studyCatalog.ts. Stage rules: apply the two stated local edit transformations and show their resulting tokens, style, focus, selection or highlight. W-367 (2026-10-14, demo-builder): observation() in StudyLesson.tsx gets a preview-replace-all branch at step 1; before, it said "The highlighted position is 1" while both red tokens (positions 1 and 3) were highlighted. Fixed after FC LH-1 dispute; awaiting fact-checker re-check.
